plan.notes: Official UW-Whitewater Academic Catalog four-year plan for Computer Science - Game Development Emphasis (Total Units: 122 as published; 15+15+16+15+15+16+15+15 = 122). The emphasis is offered as BA/BS; recorded as BS. The plan itself notes all students must earn 120 credits for a bachelor's degree and the plan is one suggested path. Gen-ed courses whose titles are not published in the plan (ENGLISH 101/102, MATH 142/151, COMPSCI 165, INTRAUNV 104, PEGNRL 192, CORE 110/120/130/140/390, COMM 110, PHYSCS 130/140/180) are recorded with neutral titles and the code preserved. COMPSCI 221 preferred for the intermediate programming slot. MAGD 488 is repeatable; required at least once. Catalog edition year not printed on uww-public.courseleaf.com; current edition as accessed 2026-10-10.
